name: Experimental civilization soldier art pack
scope: Experimental Saracen longbow and Byzantine, Saracen and Egyptian longsword graphics integrated into the game renderer. Corrected Byzantine and Egyptian sprites use long blades and two-handed grips without shields. Original Viking and Frank longsword graphics are retained.
integration: Application builds copy remaster.lib beside the executable. The generated draft models were rejected after in-game review and are now opt-in with -remaster_sprites:2. Default mode 1 uses native civilization figures and complete original animations as the foundation; their missing weapon artwork remains unfinished. Mode 0 disables the civilization appearance adaptation. Experimental startup reads BMD and PCX directly without registering another global file library or replacing native tables. Source-tree experimental runs also search assets/remaster/remaster.lib. Configuration fragments are illustrative and must not replace native tables.
validation: All fourteen archive entries were reread. All 256 body frames match the packed source alpha and quantized RGB. Four C++ profiles match the unit catalog; 24 player-palette variants were reviewed. Two changed Win32 units pass syntax checking without warnings. No game build or execution.
next: Replace the rejected generated models with faithful original-figure weapon additions, preserving native proportions, facings, shadows and full idle/walk/action animation. The generated preview is historical experimental art, not the default game appearance. Verify native default and opt-in modes after an explicit rebuild.
